# Basalt catalog

> Build with Basalt: an open-source React UI library with matte components, charts, and dashboard templates. TypeScript, light and dark themes, MIT licensed.

Install `@nocoo/basalt`. Browse the live catalog at https://basaltui.com/ui.
Each URL below is a public documentation surface.

## Inline

[Overview](https://basaltui.com/ui/overview/inline): Small pieces of context that belong beside text, not above it.

- [Badge](https://basaltui.com/ui/badge)
- [Tag Badge](https://basaltui.com/ui/tag-badge)
## Actions

[Overview](https://basaltui.com/ui/overview/action): Controls for entering values, choosing options and committing intent.

## Blocks

[Overview](https://basaltui.com/ui/overview/block): Reusable page-level patterns composed from the same component rules.

- [Delete Resource](https://basaltui.com/ui/delete-resource)
- [Page Header](https://basaltui.com/ui/page-header)
- [Resource List](https://basaltui.com/ui/resource-list)
